notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Made it so in the Dark World enemies only respawn when you switch maps.
- Nerfed Cannon Boss so she cannot one hit the player brutally anymore
- Sewer boss got their mechanics fixed where they could be killed before their strength ran out, that no longer happens.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a lot of tiny bugs
- Buffed Guard so as it reflects, it also generates 40 TP now so the player won't be helpless after guarding.
- Nerfed a boss for its notorious strength. He is no longer overpowered.
- removed Dot debuff from one of the levels as it served no purpose other than being annoying.
